323-1084-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
323-1084-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
323-1084-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1170-1329-1414-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4772-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2724-7068-8172.description:
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

261-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2350-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat

250-779-1315-1479-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1315-1479-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1479-2841-6157-7885.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-7885.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

914-3036-5434.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-5434.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

864-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3533-4658-7416.notablePrerequisites: You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
3533-4658-7416.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Soul of Eternity and gain life equal to its toughness.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

2082-3490-4779-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-3490-4779-7426.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat

3490-4476-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4476-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

27-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3617-4863-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Revolutionist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2116-2438-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

1339-2122-4050-7315.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-7315.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2842-5170-6132-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2210-6575.description:
Activate Terra by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
Esper Terra enters with a lore counter on it, triggering its first chapter ability, creating a token copy of Mirrormade with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Put the oldest Esper Terra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Mirrormade token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Mirrormade token trigger, creating a token copy of Mirrormade with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2210-6575.notes: You can stack additional Esper Terra triggers and resolve them later for more tokens and mana.

413-803-1789-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
413-803-1789-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Blasting Station trigger.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2908-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Dream Stalker
2908-5674-5870.description:

When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-1671-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

240-413-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Egg or a creature with changeling.

When the creature dies, Atla Palani and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing the creature from the top of your library and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing one damage to any target.
Repeat.

2703-3518-4068-5112.description:

Holding priority, activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing Mairsil and discarding your hand, adding {3}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 1, creating a token copy of it.

618-3396-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Quirion Sentinel with haste.
Quirion Sentinel enters the battlefield, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1106-1812-2034-2302.description:
Activate Oona for {X} = 2 spending {2}{U/B}.

The opponent you targeted mills two cards and you create two faerie rogue creature tokens.
Sacrifice both tokens to Ashnod's Altar to add 4 {C}.
Pay {C}{C} to add {U/B} with Prismite.

2540-3430-4449.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2540-3430-4449.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {2}{R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
